yrbs_scale: Q59 1=never had intercourse; 2=had but not in past 3 months; 3-8=one to six-or-more partners in past 3 months. Q61 1=never had intercourse; 2=condom used; 3=not used
mcs_scale: FCSEXX00 -9/-8/-1 missing codes; 1=Yes; 2=No (last 12 months). FCCONP0A -9/-8/-1 missing codes; 1=used a condom; 2=used another form of contraceptive; 3=used none
recode_rule: TARGET=3-level h_recent_sex_condom_status with levels no_recent_intercourse (reference), recent_no_condom, recent_condom. MCS reads BOTH variables RAW, before missing-code cleaning: FCSEXX00=2 -> no_recent_intercourse; FCSEXX00=1 AND FCCONP0A in {2,3} -> recent_no_condom; FCSEXX00=1 AND FCCONP0A=1 -> recent_condom; every other combination, including -1, -8, -9 and system missing, stays missing. FCSEXX00=-1 is NOT read as no recent intercourse because it combines structural routing with administration-mode skipping. YRBS: Q59 in {1,2} -> no_recent_intercourse; Q59 in {3,4,5,6,7,8} AND Q61=3 -> recent_no_condom; Q59 in {3,4,5,6,7,8} AND Q61=2 -> recent_condom; every other combination, including missing, CDC-blanked and contradictory values, stays missing. The active-and-answered combination is CDC's own QN61 denominator. Both Q59 and Q61 are required and their absence is an error
rationale: MCS distinguished intercourse in the previous 12 months, while YRBS Q59 used the previous three months. MCS availability additionally depended on self-completion and preceding contact routing. Only explicit, internally consistent states were coded; administrative, non-response and indeterminate cases remained missing. Enters the model schema as two indicators against no_recent_intercourse, never as a 0/1/2 scale. Sources: 2023 YRBS Data Users Guide pp.41-42 and p.9 (edit rules); UKDS SN 8156 Sweep 6 dictionary FCSEXX00 and FCCONP0A; MCS6 Young Person Questionnaire pp.38-41

mcs_scale: -1=not applicable; -8=don't know; -9=don't want to answer; 1=used a condom; 2=used another form of contraceptive; 3=did not use any contraception
rationale: No sufficiently comparable retained predictor. MCS condom-use availability depended on self-completion mode, preceding routing questions and reported intercourse within the previous 12 months; YRBS Q61 directly recorded condom use at last intercourse without an equivalent reference-period or administration restriction. MCS route (Young Person Questionnaire p.41): the Relationships section {WRRY to CONP} was not asked when interviewer-administered; SEXX was asked only where TCHP or TCOP recorded fondling; CONP was asked only where SEXX recorded intercourse in the previous 12 months. MCS -1 is therefore an administrative not-asked state with several causes rather than a report of no intercourse, whereas YRBS code 1 is an explicit self-report. Not retained as a predictor of its own. The condom information both cohorts do carry is instead one arm of the combined three-level predictor recorded on the Recent intercourse and condom use row, where it is conditioned on recent intercourse rather than standing alone. Sources: 2023 YRBS Data Users Guide p.42; UKDS SN 8156 Sweep 6 dictionary FCCONP0A; MCS6 Young Person Questionnaire p.41
